column1: # Penumbra's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the screen's text <TAB> what to say. "#" a number, "*" a
# word left out. tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json (published with the site) and the link the
# FM-1 sends. Change a line and a new file is made: keep the old ones (devices in the wild point at them).
# The words files are not published yet (design phase 6): until they are, the reader says the screen's text.
